title: Introduction to Design Engineering
content: purpose of design in SE requirements vs design. Design is the technical kernel of software engineering. It encompasses architecture, interfaces, components, and data.

title: Design Concepts
content: abstraction, refinement, modularity, separation of concerns, information hiding. functional independence cohesion coupling. Design patterns and refactoring.

title: The Design Model
content: five design elements data architectural interface component deployment. Multiple views are required to fully model a complex system.

title: Data Design
content: data objects structures database in-memory mapping integrity. Mapping analysis-level data to design-level structures.

title: Architectural Design
content: architectural styles layered client server pipe filter MVC quality attributes. The overarching structure of the software.

title: Interface Design
content: UI component system interfaces user-centered basic. Consistency, feedback, error handling. Interfaces as contracts.

title: Component-Level Design
content: components classes modules specification control flow. OO vs traditional component design. Design for reuse.

title: Deployment Design
content: mapping software to hardware nodes processes communication links. Scalability, reliability, and deployment diagrams conceptually.

title: Pattern-Based Design
content: what patterns are, why used, idioms, benefits, limitations. Reusing proven solutions to common design problems.

title: Design Quality & Evaluation
content: correctness completeness consistency traceability reviews. Validating the design against requirements.
